issues.description: Field type mismatch for numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md lines 63-72) declares these two attributes as type double, while the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10) declares them as int. The UML also shows getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int, which implies integer totals. This inconsistency can confuse students about which numeric type to use (int vs double) and whether methods that compute totals should return int or double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric types consistent across materials. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int to match the reference solution and the getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int signature. Alternatively, if fractional student counts are intended, change the template and solution to use double for those attributes and adjust related methods (e.g., have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return double and update any examples/tests accordingly). Document the chosen type in the task text so students know which to implement.
